flags: Bartolomeo Vanzetti: the 1925 notice prints his birthday as June 19, but his documented date of birth — already recorded — is June 11, 1888; the notice entry is presumably a printing error and nothing was changed.

Herman Suhr: the notice appears to print Herman O. Suhr while the Wheatland prisoner is usually Herman D. Suhr — the middle initial awaits independent verification; the stored name (no middle initial) is untouched.

Frank Martel (president, Detroit Federation of Labor) and Frank Brunton (secretary, Detroit auto workers union) are reported arrested in the same issue during an organizing struggle, but the article does not establish that either was sentenced — per the curator they classify as labor arrestees, not confirmed political prisoners, and NO records were created; revisit if custody evidence surfaces.
The curator's note about the issue was cut off mid-sentence (it ends: The issue also claims that P) — whatever followed has not been received or processed.
All June birthdays from the notice lack birth years and therefore live in the biographies; a date field cannot hold a day without a year.
